title.narrative: 1.1. STRENGTHENING NATIONAL LEVEL CAPACITY FOR CHILD HEALTH AND WELL-BEING

description.narrative: National Government has enhanced capacities to develop, finance, implement and monitor policies and plans for equitable Maternal, Neonatal, and Child Health (MNCH), HIV/AIDS and nutrition care and services for children.

participating-org.narrative: PAEDIATRIC INFECTIOUS DISEASES UNIT UNIVERSITY OF CAPE TOWN
The Global Fund to Fight AIDS
UNIVERSITY OF KWAZULU NATAL CENTRE FOR RURAL HEALTH

mailing-address.narrative: Equity House, 659 Pienaar street, Brooklyn, Pretoria. Postal Address: PO Box 4884 Pretoria 0001

description.narrative: South Africa
South Africa

sector.narrative: End preventable maternal, newborn and child deaths
Evidence generation and policy advocacy for immunization
Existence of national costed ECD action plans and family friendly policies
Guideline development and Technical Support for HIV prevention, treatment and care
HIV service access and quality improvement through primary health care strengthening (integration, health system strengthening and capacity building at facility and community levels)
Provide maternal, newborn, and child health at the primary and secondary health care facilities
Risk assessment and analysis-(multi-hazard--e.g. CCRA, or natural hazards, environmental risk, and / or climate risk--e.g. CLAC)
Salt iodization and other large-scale food fortification
Technical assistance - Nutrition in early childhood
Water sector policy and administrative management
